questions.question: How should we fix the labels before freezing?

options.label: Targeted pass (Recommended)
options.description: A fresh labeller re-grades only the doubtful cases across all 60, with Astra's passage + facet rule: grade-2s on queries with no 3, flagged 1-vs-2 calls, and every 'specific' flag. Then a short re-check.

options.label: Full boundary relabel
options.description: Astra's option: re-adjudicate every grade-1 and grade-2 note and every flag across all 60. Most thorough, and the slowest.

options.label: Patch the sampled cases
options.description: Fable's option: apply only the corrections the panel agreed on (#2, #3, #4, #9 and flags), then freeze. Unsampled queries keep any leniency.

questions.question: Which of the two gate changes should go in with it?

options.label: Exploratory stratum
options.description: Topic-list and one-word queries are kept and reported, but excluded from the top-1 'specific note leads' ship floor. Small change to the gate code plus a plan amendment.

options.label: In-domain hard negatives
options.description: Add 2–3 synthetic in-domain questions the library can't answer to the public seed, so the honesty gate is tested on a realistic gap.
